iti31:2.3: Idha bhikkhave ekacco katakalyāṇo hoti kata-kusalo katabhīruttāṇo, akatapāpo akatatthaddho akata-kibbiso.
iti31:2.4: So kataṃ me kalyāṇan-ti pi na tappati, akataṃ me pāpan-ti pi na tappati.
iti31:2.5: Ime kho bhikkhave dve dhammā atapanīyā ti.
